stem: Voltmarkt computes Belgium's LFL sales growth for March 2025 against March 2024. Seven Belgian stores, all open since before 2023, took €2.40 million in March 2024 and €2.46 million in March 2025. The Gent store, open since 2015, took €0.30 million in March 2024 but was closed for all of March 2025 for a refit. Mechelen opened on 1 March 2025 and took €0.18 million that month. A store counts only when it opened at least 12 full months before the first day of the same month last year and had sales in both months. What is Belgium's LFL growth for March 2025? Give a percentage with 1 decimal.
